g.text: Asgard K3s: the one production cluster
Six VMs spread over three hosts. Flux deploys everything from main; Calico and K3s itself come from Ansible.
Six VMs: a control plane and a worker on each Proxmox host
K3s addon files on the init node,
Zabbix and Jellyfin are LXCs by
design. No AWX, Grafana or n8n here.
Sources: docs/services/asgard-k3s.md, docs/known-issues/networking-multi-homed-workers.md. Workers are multi-homed; the four network fixes in the k3s role must never be hardened away.
